title: Lingual Tonsil Hypertrophy Grading and Its Relation to Sociodemographic Factors and Clinical Symptoms
brief_summary: The aim of this research was to evaluate the lingual tonsil hypertrophy (LTH) grading of patients with dysphagia using videolaryngoscopy and determine the relation of LTH grades to sociodemographic factors and clinical symptoms.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults
* Consent for participating in the research
* No cognitive disorders or mental illnesses
* Complaining about difficulty swallowing (research group)
* Enlarged lingual tonsils on videolaryngoscopy (research group)
* Generally healthy, no complaints of swallowing disorders (control group)
* Normal-sized lingual tonsils (control group)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Refusal to participate in the research
* Younger than 18 and older than 80 years old
* Serious mental or cognitive conditions
